sections.heading: PhysX Breakoperator
sections.content: The PhysX Break operator can be used to break PhysX bindings.

sections.heading: Bind breaking
sections.content:
None: disables PhysX bind breaking.All: breaks all PhysX bindings of affected particles.Random (per step): the “breaks/frame” setting controls how many PhysX bindings will be broken per time step, across all applicable event particles.Random (per particle): the “breaks/frame” setting controls how many PhysX bindings will be broken per-particle .Breaks/frame: the maximum number of PhysX bindings to break per frame.

None: disables PhysX bind breaking.

All: breaks all PhysX bindings of affected particles.

Random (per step): the “breaks/frame” setting controls how many PhysX bindings will be broken per time step, across all applicable event particles.

Random (per particle): the “breaks/frame” setting controls how many PhysX bindings will be broken per-particle .

Breaks/frame: the maximum number of PhysX bindings to break per frame.

Amount %: the percentage of PhysX bindings to break.Variation %: the per-particle percentage of variation to apply.

Amount %: the percentage of PhysX bindings to break.

sections.heading: Filter
sections.content:
Filter By ID: controls whether only PhysX bindings with a matching ID will be broken.ID: the ID to match.

Filter By ID: controls whether only PhysX bindings with a matching ID will be broken.

ID: the ID to match.

sections.heading: Break Bind Types
sections.content: [Types]: controls which PhysX binding types will be affected.

sections.heading: Test TRUE When
sections.content:
Break any bindings: particles will satisfy the test condition when any of their PhysX bindings are broken.Break all bindings: particles will only satisfy the test condition when all of their PhysX bindings are broken.

Break any bindings: particles will satisfy the test condition when any of their PhysX bindings are broken.

Break all bindings: particles will only satisfy the test condition when all of their PhysX bindings are broken.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content: Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.

sections.heading: Slicing Rollout
sections.content:
The Slicing rollout controls whichtySlicerobjects will be used to slice PhysX bindings.

For best results, when usingtySlicers, enable “evaluate operator after PhysX” in the PhysX Bind’s timing rollout.

Input object list: thetySlicerobjects to use for PhysX bind slicing.
